entries.title: Putting a card away never ends its task
entries.body: Every card now has one minus that only puts it away. Plans keep their choices and drafts, and permission requests wait for an explicit answer. Answer notes have a separate Done button, also available in the task’s record after the note is put away. Time alone never ends the task.

picture.alt: An answer note has one minimize minus after Maximize and a separate Done button below its answer
